# Governance

AI Kit is owned and maintained by [AINative Studio](https://ainative.studio). This is not a community-governed open-source project in the meritocracy/foundation sense — there is no elected maintainer body, steering committee, or formal contributor-promotion ladder.

## Decision-making

- **Roadmap and architecture**: decided by the AINative Studio engineering team.
- **Pull requests**: reviewed and merged by AINative Studio maintainers. External PRs are welcome (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)) but merge decisions rest with the maintaining team, not a vote.
- **Releases**: cut by AINative Studio via the `pnpm release` / `changesets` process documented in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- **Breaking changes**: require a maintainer-approved changeset and a CHANGELOG entry (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)).

## License

AI Kit is MIT-licensed (see [LICENSE](../LICENSE)) — the code itself is fully open source and freely usable, even though project governance is company-controlled rather than community-run.

## Contact

- Bugs/features: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/AINative-Studio/ai-kit/issues)
- Questions: see [SUPPORT.md](./SUPPORT.md)
